authorized_transition.name: mac.r6.pairing-predecessor.ensure-v1
authorized_transition.summary: Following durable completion and revalidation of the already-admitted fixed R3 install, the exact existing privileged macOS executor may perform one closed, domain-separated protected-state transition that creates or restores the current R6 pairing predecessor and emits its corresponding data-only pairing continuation.
authorized_transition.caller_role: The canonical installer may request this exact transition and display or persist its returned data-only continuation. It may not select an action, path, generation, expiry, identity, digest, anchor, signature payload, or raw Stage-1 authority.
authorized_transition.producer_role: The existing privileged macOS executor derives every authority field from protected state, the durably completed R3 receipt, the finalized PM mapping, the observed guest identity and home, and the manifest-bound guest Linux executor identity.
preconditions: the original R3 fixed-install effect was admitted while its Stage-1 authority was valid
the literal fixed-install plan is durably complete and revalidated against current protected state and guest observation
the committed R3 completion receipt and exact pre-CAS completed-install parent anchor are available
no pairing effect is already EffectStarted or Consumed for the current generation
the host Mach-O helper identity and guest AArch64 ELF executor identity are independently typed and exact
required_predecessor_bindings: exact producer host code identity and signer SPKI
fixed-install plan identity and durable completion receipt
observed guest home and managed guest Substrate home
guest executor role, ELF format, AArch64 architecture, SHA-256, size, and manifest binding
authorized_transition.anchor_law: The predecessor is signed against the pre-CAS completed-install parent anchor. The emitted continuation binds the post-CAS committed predecessor anchor or exact CAS receipt. The two anchors must be distinct fields and must never be represented by an ambiguous current-anchor value.
authorized_transition.identity_law: Host Mach-O control/helper image identities and guest AArch64 ELF executor identities use distinct types, fields, parsers, comparisons, and tests. Neither digest may substitute for the other.
authorized_transition.expiry_law: The pairing-only continuation receives a fixed, non-caller-selectable 300-second validity window beginning only after both predecessor and continuation bytes are durably persisted. This does not renew, extend, or replay the original Stage-1 effect authority.
authorized_transition.stage_one_expiry_law: Original Stage-1 validity is checked when the fixed-install effect is admitted. Once admitted and durably precommitted, expiry does not prevent convergence or recovery of that exact effect. No new install effect may begin from expired Stage-1 authority.
authorized_transition.lost_response_law: An exact retry returns the exact persisted predecessor and continuation bytes and never re-signs equivalent content.
authorized_transition.generation_law: At most one live pairing predecessor generation may exist. An expired unused generation may be replaced only through this dedicated operation when fixed-install state is unchanged and no pairing effect is EffectStarted or Consumed. CAS consumes the expired generation and creates the next; every old continuation remains permanently rejected.
authorized_transition.consumption_law: The protected state machine is Available -> PairingEffectStarted -> Consumed. A clean pre-effect failure may remain Available or converge by exact retry. Any effect-visible or ambiguous failure must not restore availability. Successful retry returns the original receipt.
authorized_transition.continuation_law: The returned continuation is pairing-only, data-only, non-auto-running, contains no pairing ticket or reusable secret, and requires the already-authorized independent guest terminal confirmation before any pairing effect.

required: bind the managed guest Substrate home to the observed guest home plus /.substrate rather than creating the already-existing Lima account home
make every EffectStarted filesystem mutation convergent with verified same-filesystem temporary objects, fsync, atomic publication, exact temp recovery, and generation-correct staging keys
make root-side adoption transactional with exact rollback or preserving stop before committed provenance
make systemd own or revalidate volatile runtime paths after reboot
order socket/service activation so socket activation cannot create a Before-only retry wedge
prove exact unit identities, socket owner/group/mode, and protocol-level endpoint readiness before completion
use field-specific systemd encoding and preserve valid prefixes containing spaces
populate canonical nonempty R6 scope, prefix, principal, mapping, and carrier fields and exercise the production validator
reject macOS --world-netfilter before privileged mutation and reject it again in the privileged executor until separately authorized
fixed_install_remediation.artifact_ingress: Retain exactly the four existing manifest-bound AArch64 Linux roles. Preserve external locked/offline build provenance, no-follow regular-file verification, and transactional adoption. No new binary target is authorized.
fixed_install_remediation.readiness_gate: R6 predecessor production is disabled until fixed-install durability, recovery, service/socket readiness, and endpoint proof all pass.

implementation_fence.new_path_rule: A path outside this fence requires a stop unless it is an existing colocated test module inside an authorized product path. No production-path inference is permitted.

required_proof: base-red and final-green tests for schema closure, typed host/guest identity separation, two-anchor semantics, 300-second issuance, exact lost-response replay, expired-unused replacement, single-use consumption, and Stage-1-expiry convergence
interruption and retry tests for every filesystem publication boundary, including partial temporary objects, changed generations, rollback, and reboot-loss of volatile paths
executable adversarial tests for four-role adoption, guest transfer, unit projection, activation ordering, socket metadata, endpoint readiness, prefix spaces, and netfilter rejection
locked/offline exact four-role AArch64 build and identity inspection outside every checkout
macOS control/executor compilation, focused Rust and shell tests, formatting, diff, allowlist, frozen-platform, and secret checks
fresh causal cascading review through terminal CLEAN with zero unresolved P1 or P2 before commit and publication
prohibited_actions: generic lifecycle scheduler, caller selector, catalogue traversal, Stop, Remove, Restore, or destructive repair
new helper, transport, endpoint, VSock route, ownership-separated Lima migration, or pairing architecture pivot
automatic pairing, embedded pairing ticket, reusable pairing secret, or terminal-confirmation bypass
renewal or replay of the original Stage-1 effect authority
host Mach-O and guest ELF digest conflation
macOS netfilter enablement or silent ignore
new Cargo target, manifest, or lockfile change
Windows, WSL, ordinary Linux-host behavior change, native evidence, MAC-CLOSEOUT, successor dispatch, or platform cleanup
blocker_policy: Adjudicate exact clerical and in-fence test issues. Stop for any new authority, architecture, identity, recovery, platform, or unresolved P1/P2 contradiction.
